answer: Web-of-trust attestation depth scoring at the quill: each identity must be vouched by 3 independent members with depth ≥2. The island isolates clusters — an attacker's fake ring forms its own disconnected component, flagged when cross-attestation density drops below 0.1. The fable of cheap sybils collapses: forging depth-3 trust across 500 identities costs 1,500 verifiable attestations, each requiring real stake and time-locked reputation. Honest nodes cluster densely; farms fragment. That asymmetry is why it works.
